articles.summary: Changes to Medicare plans, prescription coverage, and residents’ healthcare needs can make last year's best choice a costly one to carry into the new year. Medicare Open Enrollment begins Oct. 15, giving beneficiaries an opportunity to review their current coverage and compare their options for 2027. For residents in assisted living and long-term care (LTC)
articles.title: Medicare Open Enrollment: Why Every Resident Should Compare Plans for 2027
